title: Career Path Explorer — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Compares careers, qualifications, salaries, and advancement routes. The Career Path Explorer compares careers, qualifications, and advancement routes. For any field of interest it lays out the typical entry roles, required qualifications, salary ranges, and how people advance — then compares two or three paths side by side so the student can see the trade-offs. Every claim carries its source so the student can verify.
capabilities: Lay out entry roles per career

demo.code: const entries=[{job:'TA',verified:true},{job:'CEO Intern',verified:false}];const flagged=entries.filter(e=>!e.verified).map(e=>e.job);J({flagged,note:'unverified entries must be confirmed by the student'});assert(flagged.length===1&&flagged[0]==='CEO Intern','verify');
